scope: Official MuJoCo WASM simulation and independent numerical validation; not hardware admission

boundaries.timingScope: Host-specific synchronous simulation measurements, not exclusive WCET or physical sensor-to-actuator timing
boundaries.observerCalibrationData: Disclosed simulated truth/noise; no real sensor-only calibration dataset
boundaries.browserWebMCP: Adapter tests use an explicit shim; normal UI and physics separately tested without it
boundaries.rendering: Canvas 2D projection of compiled MuJoCo geometry, not native OpenGL rendering

provenance: Exact numerical source hashes and asset identity are recorded in native_reference.json and commissioning.json. Completed commissioning sections were resumed only with matching source hashes; final hashes were independently checked against the current files.
historicalEvidence: Earlier failed QP parity remains in native_reference_before.json and Git history. The former handwritten box-QP optimizer was replaced by pinned upstream quadprog; acceptance tolerances were not relaxed.
